notes.title: Update - QuestEvent 0.7
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

You all see that we are behind schedule of the planned launch date of the new version.. We are very sorry about that!

[b]Why is it taking so long?[/b]
We know that is almost 8 months since the last update that we released. But that has also a reason.
We working on the full expansion of Dungeoneering in stead of a seperated update for that.  Dungeoneering is a unique and hard piece of sscripting that requires a lot of work. Beside that we are also working on the perfect balancing of Mining and Smithing together with the new Combat Systeem.

But... We will reveale a new release date of QuestEvent V1!


[b]QuestEvent 1? Ans 0.7, 0,8 and 0.9 then?[/b]
It will be a huge step forward to release all those content at the same time.
As we do not seperate the updates anymore but release it all at once, we decidede to make it QuestEvent V1.  Everything will be completed of what is in the game at that point. 


[b]So...Okay... What is the new Release Date?[/b]
We are sorry to announce that it will not be in this year anymore =(
But we will start 2017 fresh with a very big update.

The new release date is....
[spoiler]February 2017[/spoiler]

It is still a long time to wait, but the wait will be worth it.

We hope that you all have a nice Christmas and a happy new year!

See you next year =)

QE Team

notes.title: Work in Progress: QuestEvent - Fall Update
notes.notes:
Dear players,

On this moment we are working hard on the newest version of QuestEvent.  As it has been a long time since the last update (April 2016) we like to tell you why it takes so long.

We are working on 2 new skills that will affect the combat system. We are also bringing in around 100 new items into the game. And to get those 2 new skills to work, we need more maps.  Just a lot of work to design and script.

[b]What will be in the update?[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Mining Skill
[*] Smithing Skill
[*] New Weapons
[*] New Armour
[*] Dungeoneering Skill Expansion I *
[*] More places to cook.
[*] Woodcutting Skill Expansion II **
[*] Firemaking Skill Expansion ***
[*] And even more...
[/list]

* = We will update the current dungeon and add all the EASY ones so you have more dungeons to play with. This will be the first step to the huge Dungeoneering Update!

** = We will introduce the Yew Tree (Level 60) and the Magic Tree (Level 75)

*** = We will add the Yew and Magic logs.


[b]Okay Cool!, But when we can expect the update?[/b]
We will not hesitate the update because there will be a lot of new things to do. And we want it to make it perfect. No any bugs might squeeze into the final release. 

The ETA of the Fall Update (QuestEvent 0.7) will be on...
[spoiler]1 December 2016[/spoiler]

We all hope to see you at the release date and hope you all will have fun with it!

Regards,
QE Team

notes.title: Update Blog Week #10
notes.notes:
Dear Players,
In this article we will bring you along the process of our new QuestEvent Update that is comng out End of March 2016!

This week we will annnounce the updates that are in it and explain a bit more about some of them. 

[h1]Update list[/h1]
Down below you find a list of the new content that will be released with the new update.
[list]
[*] Fishing Expansion
[*] Cooking Skill
[*] Mining Skill
[*] Smithing Skill
[*] Hitpoints updated
[*] Bug Fixes
[*] and some little things
[/list]

This is just a short list. More things can be added later on.

[h1]Fishing Expansion[/h1]
This week we will talk about the Fishing Expansion.

On this moment you can only fish some Raw Fish.
Raw Fish will be replaced with Raw Shrimps in the update, so you don't lose any fish you catched so far.

Beside of that little thing we have added another 11 fish sorts.
Sardine, Anchovies, Herring, Trout, Pike, Salmon, Tuna, Lobster, Swordfish, Shark and Manta Ray.
They are all spread out over the Fishing skill. The highest fish is the ?Manta Ray that can be catched on level 91 Fishing. The lowest one is Shrimps (LEvel 1) and Sardine (Level 5).

With the raw fishes you can go to a Cooking Range and cook them for Cooking XP!
But more about cooking next week.

Thanks for reading this first Blog Post of QE
Please leave some feedback down in the comments so we can adjust the fishing skill if needed with your given feedback.

Regards,
QE Team

notes.title: Update: QuestEvent V0.5!
notes.notes:
Today we releasing a new build of QuestEvent with a new feature that helps you levelling some faster! Read more here down below.

[h1]Bonfires[/h1]
The QE team has been working hard to implement the "Bonfire" upgrade for the next update. 

Players will now be able to burn up to 24 logs of any type automatically without waiting for the fire to burn out. (as long as you have the necessary Firemaking level for the log and the logs in your inventory) .

 This makes leveling up your Firemaking skill much faster, as you no longer have to wait for each fire to burn out before burning another log. 


[h1]Rebalancing Firemaking / Woodcutting[/h1]
After some complains that Woodcutting takes a lot of time we have looked into it to change some times of cutting those logs.  Down below you find a list of what we did.

[list]
[*]Reduced Willow Cutting from 4 seconds to 3 seconds. (per log)
[*]Reduced Maple Cutting from 5.8 seconds to 4 seconds. (per log)
[*]Firemaking with Bonfire Technic: 1 log every 2.5 seconds (24 per fire / minute)
[/list]


[h1]Other News & Patch Notes[/h1]
Beside the update, we made some small changes to the existing content:
[list]
[*]The statue in Clevertown now has a description to read.
[*]The man (Potion Quest at the beginning) will now Always randomly move and won't block your way anymore.
[*]We checked and corrected some English Spelling / Grammar
[*]Bandit Quest 2 has been added to the Level-up message. (15 Firemaking)
[/list]

That's the update for this time.
Enjoy QuestEvent and see you next week with the Minimap Update!

Regards,
QE Team

notes.title: Update: QuestEvent V0.3.3
notes.notes:
Hello!

This morning we have updated the game to V0.3.2 and added LEvel-Up Messages and an ingame Updater.

After the launch we found some bugs and have fixed this.
We also added a new feature to the Woodcutting skill.

[h1]More Oaks Logs from 1 tree![/h1]
Tired of chopping down an oak tree and getting 1 log?
We have added a feature that you will get between 1 and 12 oak logs each tree!  Every animations means 1 log + 38xp.  You can get 12 oak loags from 1 oak tree at once. so that is 456xp in Woodcutting!  This is all at random. so you can get 2 logs from a tree and 7 from an other one.  When the tree regrows, you can chop it down again and will get an random amount of logs again.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
We found that you cant lit Oak Logs at the old man house (Quest about cabbage)  This has been fixed now.

Because of the Oak Log adding feature, we decided to call it V0.3.3.

If there are any bugs you encounter, please report hem at our Steam Discussion: Bugs Found!

Next week we will release the Bandit Quest 2 and Standard FullScreen.
See you next week.

Regards,
QE-Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - 11th of April
notes.notes:
The following Patch Notes are some changes that me made along with the game update.
We have listed the most important fixes.
We have categorized them to make it easier for you. 

[h1]Skills:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Oak Logs can be used now for Firemaking, This gives you 60xp. You need level 15 Firemaking for that.
[*] When you lit a fire or catching a fish, the time has been reduced with 50%.
[*] Tree trunks in dungeons gives 10xp in Woodcutting now.
[/list]

[h1]Monsters:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Slimes will give XP and Gold now in the Dungeons.
[*] Bandits XP and Gold reduced to 5xp and 10 Gold when killing.
[/list]

[h1]Text:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added explanation of Exploring in the Tutorial.
[*] Removed the Fishing Spots error message when starting a Dungeon.
[/list]

[h1]Scripts:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fishing spots in Dungeons are fixed. They will stay of you don't have a fishing net.
[*] Fireplaces re-scripted. They now are bug free and working perfectly.
[*] Automatically In-game Updater scripted. You still need to update via Steam.
[*] Expanded the amount of units you can carry with you per item to unlimited.
[*] Fireplaces in Dungeons reworked and re-scripted and go out after restarting a Dungeon.
[/list]

[h1]Others:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fishing Net is now buy-able in the Tools Shop in Clevertown
[*] Teleportation after completing/leaving a dungeon has been fixed.
[*] Dungeon freezing has been fixed.
[*] Boots Defence was 0. This has been fixed with all of the boots.
[*] Game has been secured to prevent stealing.
[/list]
